title: Implement deterministic analytics calculators
businessObjective: Provide deterministic measurement input for later intelligence without live analytics ingestion, reporting, provider invocation, or operational action.
technicalObjective: Implement exactly the V1 local schemas, pure calculator, validator, documentation, state, and evidence defined by GOV-038.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, credentials, or live data access is authorized.
Callers supply prepared finite observations; P2-001 does not query, persist, mutate, or redefine P1 authorities.
A separate governance task must admit the exact validator before independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly two closed Draft 2020-12 authorities exist: `schemas/deterministic-analytics-calculator-request-v1.schema.json` and `schemas/deterministic-analytics-calculator-result-v1.schema.json`; every object sets `additionalProperties: false` and implements the exact V1 fields, types, bounds, and variants in the GOV-038 design.

Exactly one pure public function, `calculateMetricComparison(request)`, exists at `packages/analytics-sdk/src/deterministic-analytics-calculators-v1.mjs`; its stable public API hides validation, rounding, reason-code, and confidence internals, reads no files, environment, network, database, clock, or mutable external state, and never throws for malformed input.

The core follows ports-and-adapters boundaries: it imports no infrastructure or provider-specific dependency; prepared observations are its input port and deterministic result its output port. Any future source, report, or provider integration is a separately approved adapter outside the core.

Only `event-count -> sum`, `event-value-sum -> sum`, `event-value-mean -> mean`, and `event-rate -> rate` are valid metric/aggregation mappings. The schemas and module enforce the exact identifier expression, date-only real-calendar and ordered/non-overlapping periods, 1-366 bounded finite observations, and exact context enums/array bounds from the design.

The result schema has only `ok`, `non-comparable`, and `invalid` variants. It implements their exact null/non-null fields, confidence labels, fixed safe invalid identity/context, complete reason-code set, and fixed error precedence in the GOV-038 design. Invalid input never throws; zero baseline yields only `non-comparable` with `ZERO_BASELINE`, never Infinity, action, recommendation, authorization, approval, or execution.

`tests/analytics/validate-deterministic-analytics-calculators-v1.mjs` loads committed V1 authority and calculator code, verifies every canonical table rule, variant, reason-code precedence, repeated never-throw behavior, authority replacement rejection, and private-boundary/no-infrastructure-import rule, and runs as `node tests/analytics/validate-deterministic-analytics-calculators-v1.mjs`.

Documentation states correlation and seasonality are caller-declared context or `not-evaluated`; P2-001 does not infer causes, process guest data, ingest external analytics, invoke AI, render a report, or authorize intervention.
Independent QA confirms allowed paths, human-approval boundary, fail-closed behavior, exact admission, required tests, CI, rollback, and retained machine-readable evidence.
solEscalationTriggers: Any live data, provider, report, recommendation, authorization, approval, execution, production write, payment, booking, RLS, migration, concurrency, or workflow proposal.
Any ambiguity in numerical semantics, schema authority, invalid-input behavior, or safe admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only P2-001 schemas, module, validator, documentation, state, and evidence; preserve P1 authorities, completed records, snapshot, and external systems.
